title: Cambridge IELTS 18 — Test 1
description: Đề lẻ, chỉ có Reading và Listening — không có Writing và Speaking nên không thi thử full được. Chọn một trong hai kỹ năng để làm. Cả hai đều chấm ngay theo đáp án và ra band luôn. Phần Listening dùng một file ghi âm liền cho cả bốn phần.

questions.prompt: What problem did Chantal have at the start of the talk?

options.text: Her view of the speaker was blocked.
She was unable to find an empty seat.
The students next to her were talking.

questions.prompt: What were Hugo and Chantal surprised to hear about the job market?

options.text: It has become more competitive than it used to be.
There is more variety in it than they had realised.
Some areas of it are more exciting than others.

options.text: which is the best career in fashion.
when to choose a career in fashion.
why they would like a career in fashion.

questions.prompt: How does Hugo feel about being an unpaid assistant?

options.text: He is realistic about the practice.
He feels the practice is dishonest.

options.text: paying too much attention to how she looked
trying to earn a lot of money

how much time people have to shop for clothes

- elephants' [36] had to be monitored constantly
- tracking devices were fitted to the matriarchs
- data including the size of their tusks and [37] was taken
- elephants were taken by truck to their new reserve
Advantages of translocation at Nkhotakota Wildlife Park
- [38] opportunities
- a reduction in the number of poachers and [39]
- an example of conservation that other parks can follow
